# Graph operations · raster

Ports, defaults, and constraints come from the registered operations. Use `graph describe <op> --json` for the full structured record.

### raster.blend



Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `background` | `raster` | Required | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Input | `foreground` | `raster` | Required | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `value` | `raster` | — | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |

Guides: [guide](../headless-authoring.md#layers-depth-and-height)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe raster.blend --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### raster.mix

Crossfade aligned raster samples with optional alpha or RGB-mean coverage.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `raster` | Required | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |

| Input | `mask` | `any` | `null` |  |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} · {"amount":{"type":"number","constraints":{"min":0,"max":1},"default":1},"maskMode":{"type":"string","constraints":{"choices":["alpha","mean"]},"default":"alpha"},"invert":{"type":"boolean","default":false},"keepTransparentRGB":{"type":"boolean","default":false},"channels":{"type":"number","constraints":{"min":0,"max":15,"integer":true},"default":15}} |
